projects.title: Zillusion
projects.subtitle: Agentic data discovery and collection
projects.summary: A full-stack platform that turns a natural-language data request into ranked sources, validated collection workflows, and reusable datasets.
projects.problem: Finding a useful data source and validating its extracted fields often takes more work than the analysis itself.
projects.implementation: Connects source discovery, browser exploration, workflow generation, separate validation, and downstream data processing through an agent workflow and a web workbench.

bullets.text: Built an agentic data platform connecting natural-language requirements, source ranking, browser exploration, and generated collection workflows using FastAPI, LangGraph, and Playwright.
Integrated separate workflow validation, PostgreSQL storage, Redis-backed tasks, and a Next.js workbench with streamed execution events.

projects.title: Evolution
projects.subtitle: Agents for software testing and repair
projects.summary: An automated test, diagnosis, repair, and integration loop for a service-based AI application.
projects.problem: An AI application can return technically valid responses while still failing the user's task.
projects.implementation: Runs functional and boundary-testing pipelines, separates result evaluation from code repair, and combines HTTP traces, streamed events, logs, and Git changes for iterative integration.

bullets.text: Developed parallel functional and boundary-testing pipelines with asyncio, separating user-facing result evaluation from developer-agent diagnosis and code repair.
Combined HTTP traces, SSE events, and service logs to drive repair iterations, Git commits, and periodic integration across isolated working copies.

projects.title: AI outreach and social operations
projects.subtitle: LinkedIn AI and Xiaohongshu integrations
members: AI Rednote / 小红书搜索自动化
projects.summary: Related projects for lead discovery, qualification, messaging workflows, and scheduled social content.
projects.problem: Lead qualification and social operations involve repeated research, context collection, and channel-specific execution.
projects.implementation: Extends a LinkedIn outreach system with an email channel, operator controls, and personalized messages; pairs it with OpenClaw integrations and Rednote search experiments. These are related projects rather than a single shared codebase.

bullets.text: Extended a Django and Playwright outreach system with an SMTP/IMAP email channel, personalized connection notes, campaign controls, and an operator console.
Integrated OpenClaw-based Xiaohongshu operations with container orchestration, health supervision, content generation, and scheduled publishing; explored Rednote search automation.

projects.title: Multimodal literature RAG
projects.subtitle: Hybrid retrieval across document content
projects.summary: Retrieval over text, equations, tables, and figures in literature documents, with PDF as the current primary input and ESG papers as example material.
projects.problem: Important evidence in a document often lives in a figure, table, or equation rather than a paragraph.
projects.implementation: Combines structured PDF parsing and traceable semantic chunks with dense retrieval, SPLADE, BM25, reciprocal rank fusion, and vision-language descriptions of visual content.

bullets.text: Implemented a multimodal PDF retrieval pipeline that parses text, equations, tables, and figures into semantic chunks with document and page metadata.
Combined FAISS dense retrieval, SPLADE, BM25, and reciprocal rank fusion, using Qwen2-VL descriptions to make tables and figures searchable.

projects.title: Creator discovery and messaging
projects.subtitle: TikTok and Douyin automation
members: TikTok 主播采集与 AI 私信工具
projects.summary: Browser automation and operator tools for creator discovery, content analysis, and contextual outreach.
projects.problem: Creator research requires repetitive browsing, candidate filtering, and message preparation across platform interfaces.
projects.implementation: Uses Playwright and Flask for collection and messaging workflows, Qwen for contextual message generation, CSV exchange, task progress tracking, and packaged desktop delivery. Douyin is a separate implementation within the same experience group.

bullets.text: Built a Flask and Playwright creator-discovery workflow with CSV-based candidate handling, task progress reporting, and Qwen-assisted contextual messaging.
Delivered packaged operator tools with PyInstaller and developed a related Douyin collection and content-analysis application.

links.label: TikTok creator tools · GitHub
links.member: TikTok 主播采集与 AI 私信工具

projects.title: Storycast
projects.subtitle: AI podcast generation backend
members: Storycast AI 播客生成后端
projects.summary: A backend that connects web research, dialogue generation, speech synthesis, and podcast asset delivery.
projects.problem: Generating a podcast requires coordinating information gathering, scripting, audio generation, and application services.
projects.implementation: Combines an Express API for authentication and podcast resources with Python search and script generation, Bark speech synthesis, audio composition, and Azure Blob uploads.

bullets.text: Built an Express and MongoDB backend for authentication, podcast categories, and media resources, integrating Python research and dialogue-generation workflows.
Connected Bark text-to-speech, audio composition, and Azure Blob Storage to turn generated dialogue into stored podcast assets.

projects.title: Battery health and feature engineering
projects.subtitle: EIS, equivalent circuits, and temperature transfer
projects.type: Personal research and course project group
members: 锂离子电池 EIS/ECM 与跨温度 SOH/RUL 预测
Duke：锂电池 ECM 特征数据集生成器
projects.summary: Research and data tooling that turn electrochemical impedance measurements into interpretable features for battery health prediction.
projects.problem: Battery measurements change across temperatures and operating conditions, making health models difficult to transfer.
projects.implementation: Fits equivalent-circuit parameters to EIS data, builds reusable feature datasets, and studies LSTM baselines and domain-adversarial transfer for cross-condition SOH prediction, with related RUL experiments.

bullets.text: Built an EIS-to-feature pipeline using nonlinear equivalent-circuit fitting, SciPy, and impedance.py, and packaged a dataset generator for battery-health analysis.
Studied cross-temperature SOH prediction with LSTM baselines and domain-adversarial transfer, comparing feature relationships and model behavior across operating conditions.

projects.title: Neural-Kalman navigation
projects.subtitle: GNSS and inertial sensor fusion
members: Neural-Kalman GNSS/INS 精准农业导航复现与扩展
projects.summary: Reproduction and extension work on neural-inertial navigation for agricultural robots with intermittent GPS updates.
projects.problem: Agricultural robots need position estimates even when satellite measurements are sparse or unavailable.
projects.implementation: Studies learned motion estimation and Kalman fusion using IMU and GNSS, comparing neural and EKF/UKF baselines and working with video-to-IMU alignment tools from the upstream research ecosystem.

bullets.text: Reproduced neural-inertial navigation workflows combining high-rate IMU sequences with intermittent GNSS measurements for agricultural robot localization.
Explored neural motion estimation and Kalman correction against EKF, UKF, and neural-inertial baselines, with tools for video and IMU alignment.

projects.title: Animagine video pipeline
projects.subtitle: Text to images, speech, and composed video
members: Animagine AI 视频生成流水线
projects.summary: An experimental pipeline that coordinates text parsing, diffusion image generation, speech synthesis, and video composition.
projects.problem: A text-to-video workflow needs consistent intermediate representations across generation and media tools.
projects.implementation: Parses text into structured scene information, generates Animagine images, synthesizes speech, and assembles media through separate parsing, image, TTS, and composition modules.

bullets.text: Developed an experimental text-to-video pipeline connecting structured scene parsing, Animagine diffusion images, speech synthesis, and media composition.
Separated text parsing, image generation, TTS, and video assembly into reusable modules with example applications and test scripts.

projects.title: RLHF pipeline
projects.subtitle: SFT, reward modeling, and PPO
projects.summary: A compact language-model alignment pipeline with supervised fine-tuning, preference learning, and a custom PPO implementation.
projects.problem: A reward score alone does not show whether a language model has learned the desired behavior or exploited the reward model.
projects.implementation: Uses distilGPT-2 for preference generation, supervised fine-tuning, pairwise reward modeling, and sequence-level PPO; compares training variants, out-of-distribution behavior, and reward hacking.

bullets.text: Implemented a distilGPT-2 alignment pipeline covering supervised fine-tuning, pairwise reward-model training, and custom sequence-level PPO with KL regularization.
Compared base and aligned model variants with reward analysis, out-of-distribution evaluation, and reward-hacking checks.

projects.title: Two-tower hotel recommendation
projects.subtitle: 540_reconmend_system
projects.summary: A neural recommendation experiment that maps user and hotel features into a shared embedding space.
projects.problem: Recommendation requires a representation that connects user intent with hotel attributes.
projects.implementation: Encodes user and hotel inputs through separate PyTorch towers into normalized 32-dimensional embeddings, with similarity-based ranking and model-evaluation notebooks.

bullets.text: Implemented a two-tower PyTorch recommender encoding user and hotel features into normalized 32-dimensional embeddings for similarity-based retrieval.
Built feature preprocessing and evaluation notebooks, using batch normalization and dropout in the user and hotel encoders.

projects.title: Multitask sentence analysis
projects.subtitle: DL_Module2
projects.summary: Sentence importance regression and memory classification with neural, classical, and rule-based baselines.
projects.problem: A memory system needs to distinguish useful statements from incidental conversation.
projects.implementation: Uses a RoBERTa backbone with separate regression and classification heads, compares TF-IDF SVM/SVR and keyword baselines, and includes cross-validation and a small FAISS-backed web interface.

bullets.text: Built a multitask RoBERTa model with sentence-importance regression and long-term-memory classification heads, including selective layer freezing and early stopping.
Compared neural predictions with TF-IDF SVM/SVR and keyword baselines using cross-validation, and added a FAISS-backed sentence-analysis interface.

projects.title: Applied NLP and enterprise RAG
projects.subtitle: AIPI561_final
projects.summary: A course final submission combining sentence analysis with a professional-services document retrieval application.
projects.problem: Document QA needs retrieval, application services, evaluation, and controls around user inputs and outputs.
projects.implementation: Brings together the DL_Module2 work and a Streamlit/FAISS RAG application with AWS Bedrock, modular configuration, logging, redaction utilities, and tests. This is an integration experience; DL_Module2 is presented separately for its model work.

bullets.text: Integrated a professional-services RAG application using FAISS, Sentence Transformers, Streamlit, and AWS Bedrock as part of an applied AI course final.
Organized configuration, LLM services, logging, redaction utilities, and component tests around the document-QA workflow.

projects.title: Attention-based image interpolation
projects.subtitle: MultiAttention_Unet and 540_Final
projects.summary: A comparative image-interpolation project with a multi-frame U-Net, attention, and classical baselines.
projects.problem: Predicting an intermediate frame requires combining spatial structure with information from neighboring frames.
projects.implementation: Compares averaging and Random Forest regression against a multi-image U-Net with self- and cross-attention, using a Streamlit interface and SSIM/PSNR evaluation. The two repositories represent related versions of this work.

bullets.text: Developed multi-frame U-Net interpolation models with self- and cross-attention, comparing predictions against averaging and Random Forest baselines.
Built training and inference utilities with a Streamlit comparison interface and SSIM/PSNR image-quality evaluation.

projects.title: Explainable battery capacity prediction
projects.subtitle: XAI_ExplainableModel_Battery
projects.summary: An interpretable deep-learning experiment for battery capacity prediction from multi-temperature impedance data.
projects.problem: Prediction alone gives limited insight into which measurement regions drive a battery-health estimate.
projects.implementation: Studies a multi-branch 1D CNN on impedance inputs and uses Integrated Gradients to inspect feature contributions, with regression evaluation and visualization notebooks.

bullets.text: Built a multi-branch 1D CNN for capacity regression from multi-temperature electrochemical impedance data using PyTorch.
Applied Captum Integrated Gradients to inspect input contributions and analyzed regression behavior with MSE and R-squared evaluation.
